compositionBoundary: Admits NotebookLM advice only after deterministic lookup and only when it binds the exact corpus, citations, contradictions, unknowns, and provider receipt. Advice carries no mutation, truth, or acceptance authority.
receipt: Content-addressed advisory admission or obstruction binding stable Codex, exact corpus and lookup receipt, provider candidate and receipt, citations, unknowns, contradictions, and consideration observation.
refusal: Refuse missing or drifting corpus identity, absent provider receipt or citation, out-of-corpus citation, authority-bearing advice, or a non-admitted provider. Provider refusal yields a no-bypass obstruction.
